title: LSRP*-LA: Scalable and Anytime Multi-Agent Path Finding for Large Agents with Asynchronous Actions
abstract: arXiv:2611.33793v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Multi-Agent Path Finding (MAPF) seeks collision-free paths for multiple agents from their start locations to their goal locations while minimizing path costs. Most MAPF algorithms assume that each agent occupies a single vertex and that the actions of all agents are synchronized. These assumptions may limit the use of MAPF planners in practice. Existing planners that get rid of both assumptions either handle only a few agents or cannot improve their solutions. Recently, a planner called LSRP* was proposed, which is scalable and anytime with asynchronous actions, but still limited by that each agent occupies a single vertex. This paper develops a new planner called LSRP*-LA for MAPF for large agents with asynchronous actions (LA-MAPF-AA), where an agent can occupy several cells. LSRP*-LA is scalable and complete, and it keeps improving solution quality after the initial solution is obtained until the runtime budget depletes. We analyze

translated_title: LSRP*-LA：针对具有异步动作的大型智能体的可扩展且随时化的多智能体路径规划
translated_abstract: 多智能体路径规划（MAPF）旨在为多个智能体寻找从起始位置到目标位置的无碰撞路径，同时最小化路径成本。大多数MAPF算法假设每个智能体只占据单个顶点，并且所有智能体的动作是同步的。这些假设可能限制了MAPF规划器在实际中的应用。现有的摆脱这两个假设的规划器要么只能处理少量智能体，要么无法改进其解的质量。最近，一个名为LSRP*的规划器被提出，它具有可扩展性和随时性，并支持异步动作，但仍然受限于每个智能体只占据单个顶点。本文开发了一个名为LSRP*-LA的新规划器，用于解决具有异步动作的大型智能体MAPF问题（LA-MAPF-AA），其中智能体可以占据多个单元格。LSRP*-LA具有可扩展性和完备性，并且在获得初始解之后会持续改进解的质量，直到运行时间预算耗尽。
tldr: 本文提出了LSRP*-LA，一个可扩展、完备且随时化的多智能体路径规划器，支持占据多个单元格的大型智能体和异步动作，并能持续改进解的质量。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes LSRP*-LA, a scalable, complete, and anytime MAPF planner that supports large agents occupying multiple cells with asynchronous actions while continuously improving solution quality.
